3609.title: Path claim contention during checkout attachment
3609.rootCauseOneLine: Branchless checkout preparation immediately fails on an exclusive path claim held until another thread finishes attaching.
3609.proposedFix: Retry branchless path claims with cancellation and a bounded wait; retain exclusive claims and immediate branch-mutation refusal.
3609.caveats: Server integration reproduction with real SQLite and actual provider; live CLI frequency and provider-specific behavior were not measured.
